args.sql:
SELECT
    l.stationname AS station_name,
    l.locationtype AS location_type,
    AVG(ww.waterqualityindex) AS avg_water_quality_index,
    AVG(tswg.powerqualityindex) AS avg_power_quality_index
FROM
    location AS l
JOIN
    waterandwaste AS ww ON l.loceqref = ww.watereqref
JOIN
    thermalsolarwindandgrid AS tswg ON l.loceqref = tswg.thermaleqref
GROUP BY
    l.stationname,
    l.locationtype
ORDER BY
    l.stationname,
    l.locationtype;
